name: Loading dots
summary: Row of dots that pop in and bounce one after another, with an optional label; for loading or thinking moments.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of the dot row

params.name: y
params.note: centre y of the dot row

params.name: label
params.note: text under the dots; leave empty for none

params.name: color
params.note: dot colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

author: krakujs
